raw.details:
Event Details:

  • Dates: 28th & 29th January 2027
  • Timings: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Venue: Parul University Campus, Vadodara, Gujarat

Mode:

  • Round 1 (Online): PPT Submissions (Shortlisted teams will receive an email for the offline round)
  • Final Round (Offline): On-site prototype/presentation.

Team & Eligibility:

  • Team Size: 1 – 4 members per project
  • Inter-college teams: Allowed for every institute
  • Inter-specialization teams: Strongly encouraged
  • Open to: Students pursuing Diploma/UG/PG and external institutes across India

Competition Themes / Tracks:

  • Young Innovators for Viksit Bharat: A platform for young innovators to showcase creative ideas, working models, prototypes, and solutions addressing real-world challenges through innovation and experimentation. It is only for Diploma and School Students.
  • Digital India & Smart Technologies: Focuses on intelligent, digital, connected, automated, and data-driven technologies that improve efficiency, decision-making, productivity, and user experiences.
  • Green Tech & Sustainable Futures: Encourages innovations addressing sustainability, climate change, environmental conservation, energy efficiency, responsible resource utilization, and a greener future.
  • Make in India & Engineering Excellence: Focuses on practical engineering innovations in products, processes, systems, infrastructure, mobility, manufacturing, and related areas, demonstrating technical excellence and engineering creativity.
  • Next-Gen Frontier Technologies: For cutting-edge research, breakthrough technologies, emerging fields, and innovative approaches with the potential to transform industries and society.
  • Open Innovation for Social Impact & Inclusive Growth: Encourages innovative solutions addressing healthcare, education, governance, accessibility, business, community development, and other societal challenges to improve quality of life and promote inclusive growth.

Event Format:

  • Teams present a working project, prototype, or conceptual demo
  • Presentation must cover:
  • Project overview
  • Problem statement & objectives
  • Proposed solution & workflow
  • Technical implementation / methodology
  • Working model/demo (if applicable)
  • Expected outcomes & impact
  • Time allotted:

10–12 minutes stall presentation/demo

5–8 minutes Q&A by evaluators, plus open interaction with visitors

Prize Pool: Up to 2 lakhs

  • 1st Prize – ₹15,000 + Trophy
  • 2nd Prize – ₹11,000 + Trophy
  • 3rd Prize – ₹7,000 + Trophy
  • Best Women-Led Innovation Award
  • Best Innovation Award
  • Best Start-up Potential Award
  • Best Social Impact Award
  • Best Research & Patent Potential Award
  • People's Choice Award

Registration Fees:

  • External invited teams: No fees
  • Accommodation charges apply. 

Rules:

  • Projects must be original and created by the team; plagiarized/copied work is disqualified
  • Only shortlisted teams must have to be present onsite on the day of the event
  • Everyone should have to carry their University Consent form.
  • No Replacement available after registration
  • No Travel allowance will be provided
  • Everyone will be from the same University
  • Eligible domains: Students from any domain can register.
  • Each participant can be on only one team/project
  • All team members must attend and present (onsite)
  • Final judging decisions are binding
  • Safety and conduct rules as per university guidelines
